name: hxn-gpu-d3d12
description: Direct3D 12 for Haxe: devices, resources, root signatures, pipeline states and command lists with explicit resource barriers
releasenote: First release: adapters including WARP, buffers and textures, root signatures with root descriptors and descriptor tables, samplers, compute and graphics pipeline states from DXIL compiled at build time or HLSL, resource transitions and enhanced barriers, swap chains on a window, and execution with fences.
